About.label: THE PERSON BEHIND THE CODE
About.title: The person.
About.body: I'm Nivaldo Dantas, a software engineering graduate from IFAM. My work has taken me from research projects with PAPE/Samsung to applications and process automation at the Amazonas State Court of Accounts.
About.body2: These days, I work independently on web applications, stream metrics, and AI integrations. I like connecting the pieces: the interface someone uses, the API behind it, and the data that makes it useful.
About.philosophy: The interface someone uses. The API behind it. The data that makes it useful.

Experience.title: Different contexts.

Experience.researchBody: Designed and developed React, React Native, and SQL applications for R&D projects, working with REST APIs and software testing.
Experience.bellusBody: Svelte interfaces and n8n workflow automation.
